description: Hook commands invoke scripts/ruflo-hook.sh (resilient shim): prefers a locally-installed `ruflo`/`claude-flow` binary, falls back to `npx --prefer-offline`, and always exits 0 so a CLI/install failure never surfaces an error in Claude Code or blocks a turn. The trailing `|| true` guards the case where $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is unset (older Claude Code) — the hook then no-ops silently. This manifest is intentionally POSIX-only (Mac/Linux): it uses /bin/bash, POSIX pipelines (jq, xargs, tr), and .sh scripts, and is known-broken on native Windows. It is a separately-published legacy "claude-flow" plugin package (not in the ruflo marketplace list) with its own jq/xargs-based hook set and its own scripts/ruflo-hook.cjs that this file never references — still needs its own Windows-compatible, Node-based rewrite.

hooks.command: cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ruflo-hook.sh" post-command --command '{}' --track-metrics true --store-results true || true

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ruflo-hook.sh" post-edit --file '{}' --format true --update-memory true || true

/bin/bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CUSTOM=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".custom_instructions // \"\""); echo "🔄 PreCompact Guidance:"; echo "📋 IMPORTANT: Review CLAUDE.md in project root for:"; echo "   • 54 available agents and concurrent usage patterns"; echo "   • Swarm coordination strategies (hierarchical, mesh, adaptive)"; echo "   • SPARC methodology workflows with batchtools optimization"; echo "   • Critical concurrent execution rules (GOLDEN RULE: 1 MESSAGE = ALL OPERATIONS)"; if [ -n "$CUSTOM" ]; then echo "🎯 Custom compact instructions: $CUSTOM"; fi; echo "✅ Ready for compact operation"'

/bin/bash -c 'echo "🔄 Auto-Compact Guidance (Context Window Full):"; echo "📋 CRITICAL: Before compacting, ensure you understand:"; echo "   • All 54 agents available in .claude/agents/ directory"; echo "   • Concurrent execution patterns from CLAUDE.md"; echo "   • Batchtools optimization for 300% performance gains"; echo "   • Swarm coordination strategies for complex tasks"; echo "⚡ Apply GOLDEN RULE: Always batch operations in single messages"; echo "✅ Auto-compact proceeding with full agent context"'
